answer: In Proof of Agent, each identity locks collateral in escrow, while cryptographic evidence of coordinated equivocation groups identities into one fault cluster. If k identities sign conflicting histories, penalties scale as O(k^2), making collusion uneconomic. Detection applies an exponential multiplier to the swarm’s capital loss and asymmetrically depreciates remaining stake, so sybil splitting offers no refuge: a jade orchard fable cannot hide common control.
